title: Takeda signs US$600M AI drug discovery deal with Insilico
slides: Takeda bets $600M on AI — can it deliver new drugs?
Insilico found a lung fibrosis target without wet lab
But its AI still fails on half of preclinical tests
Takeda now funds Phase I for that one candidate
Check Insilico's clinical trial results before betting
thread_text:
1. $600M bet on AI

Takeda just wrote a check for $600 million to back an AI drug from Insilico. The candidate: a lung fibrosis treatment.

2. AI discovered the target

Insilico's platform found the fibrosis target without a single wet lab experiment. Pure digital pattern recognition.

3. But half the AI drugs fail

Insilico's own AI still fails on about 50% of preclinical tests. The algorithm is not a guarantee.

4. Phase I starts now

Takeda is funding the first human trial for that one Insilico candidate. Real risk shifts to the clinic.

5. Check the trial results

Before you assume the AI bet pays off, look up Insilico's past clinical trial outcomes. Have any passed Phase II?

instagram.caption:
A Japanese pharma giant just put $600M behind an AI-discovered drug for lung fibrosis — but Insilico’s own algorithm still fails half its preclinical tests. 🧪

The AI found that target using zero wet-lab experiments — pure pattern recognition. Takeda is now funding Phase I human trials for that one candidate. 💊

If you’re a biotech writer or analyst, this deal doesn’t prove AI works — it proves the risk just moved to the clinic. 📉

Have you checked Insilico’s past Phase II results? One survivor yet? 🔍
